code.description: The identifier of the item discount group.

description.description: Description of the item discount group.

notRelevant.description: Indicates whether the group is not relevant.

excludeFromDepPriceGen.description: Indicates whether the group is excluded from dependent price generation.

customerRelevant.description: Indicates whether the group is relevant for customers.

exclFromAutSalesPriceCalc.description: Indicates whether the group is excluded from automatic sales price calculation.

noPricebookLogic.description: Indicates whether price book logic does not apply to the group.
